items.title: Jerry Katzman, Former William Morris President, Dies at 89
items.summary: Jerry Katzman, who rose to president of the William Morris Agency over a 30-year run there, has died at 89. The son of a producer behind Elvis Presley pictures, he packaged talent for The Cosby Show, Roseanne, Murphy Brown and The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air.

items.title: Mariska Hargitay’s Best ‘Law & Order: SVU’ Episodes To Re-Air On NBC
items.summary: NBC is running a Law & Order: Special Victims Unit marathon of Mariska Hargitay's standout episodes on Thursday, Sept. 10, ahead of her stint hosting the Emmy Awards. The show's Season 28 premiere is set for Thursday, Oct. 8 at 9 p.m. ET/PT.

items.title: Fuerza Regida Announces New “This Is Our Dream” US Tour Dates
items.summary: Fuerza Regida have added a 10-date US leg to their This Is Our Dream tour, beginning in October.

items.title: Caitríona Balfe Stars In Alfonso Cuarón Horror Thriller Series ‘Ascension’ Ordered By Apple TV
items.summary: Apple TV has ordered Ascension, a horror-tinged drama from Alfonso Cuarón, with Caitríona Balfe starring and executive producing in her first series since Outlander ended. Natalie Erika James and Christian White co-showrun and share writing credit with Cuarón.

items.title: Rufus Wainwright, Kathleen Hanna, Yo La Tengo Celebrate the Radical Music of Yoko Ono
items.summary: Rufus Wainwright, Kathleen Hanna and Yo La Tengo performed at "Yoko Only," a tribute concert built around Yoko Ono's songwriting, feminist politics and influence.

items.title: Iceage Announce Spring 2027 North American Tour
items.summary: Iceage will tour North America starting in April 2027, with Los Angeles, Chicago and New York among the stops, supporting the Danish punk band's new album.

items.title: Mattel’s Whitney Houston Barbie Is Inspired by One of Pop’s Greatest Anthems: How To Shop Online
items.summary: Mattel's first Whitney Houston Barbie takes its cues from "I Wanna Dance With Somebody" and is available online.

items.title: AI Music Company Suno Unveils Download Caps for Free, Paid Tiers in Quest to Combat Abuse (EXCLUSIVE)
items.summary: Suno has detailed the download limits it announced last week for its AI music generator, part of an effort to curb abuse and gain standing in the music industry. Beginning Sept. 3, free users get seven total downloads across their library, with separate caps for paid tiers.

items.title: Charli xcx Headlines & Backstage Interviews With Jade & PinkPantheress At Outside Lands 2026 | All Access
items.summary: Billboard's sponsored All Access segment from Outside Lands 2026 covers Charli xcx's headline set plus backstage interviews with Jade, PinkPantheress and Kwn.

items.title: After Nearly 20 Years, Chris Carter Is Finally Releasing the ‘X-Files’ Movie He Had in Mind
items.summary: Chris Carter is putting out a director's cut of The X-Files: I Want to Believe, subtitled Vrach Frankenshteyn, roughly two decades after the original. He also discusses Ryan Coogler's planned take on the franchise and the congressional UFO hearings.

items.title: Allison Janney on Playing the President in ‘The Diplomat,’ Her Broadway ‘Seven-Year Itch’ and the One Genre She’s Never Tried
items.summary: Allison Janney plays the president in The Diplomat, capping close to 20 years of fictional Washington roles. She also talks about her Broadway run in The Seven-Year Itch and the one genre she has yet to attempt.

items.title: aespa on Lollapalooza, Lemonade, and the reality of K-pop idoldom
items.summary: aespa talk to The FADER about playing Lollapalooza, life as K-pop idols, and the Young Thug and Vanessa Carlton songs they play before going on.
